content:
Filter parameter একটি API-এর সবচেয়ে বেশি ব্যবহৃত কিন্তু কম টেস্ট হওয়া অংশ। ভুল filter implementation মানে ব্যবহারকারী ভুল ডেটা দেখেন — এবং বুঝতেই পারেন না।

---

Single Filter Tests

TC-FILTER-001: Filter by category
Method: GET /api/products?category=electronics
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - ALL returned products have category = "electronics"
  - No products from other categories leaked

TC-FILTER-002: Filter by price range
Query: minPrice=100&maxPrice=500
Expected: All products: 100 <= price <= 500

TC-FILTER-003: Filter by status (active/inactive)
Query: status=active
Expected: Only active products returned

TC-FILTER-004: Case-insensitive filter
Query: category=Electronics (uppercase E)
Expected: Same result as category=electronics
---

Multiple Filter Combination Tests

TC-FILTER-005: Multiple filters applied simultaneously
Query: category=electronics&status=active&minPrice=200
Expected: Products that satisfy ALL conditions (AND logic)

TC-FILTER-006: Filter + pagination
Query: category=electronics&page=2&pageSize=10
Expected: Page 2 of electronics products — filter applies consistently across pages

TC-FILTER-007: Filter + sort
Query: category=books&sort=price_asc
Expected: Only books, sorted by price ascending
---

Negative & Edge Case Tests

TC-FILTER-008: Filter by non-existent category
Query: category=nonexistentcategory
Expected:
  - Status: 200 OK
  - Response: { "data": [], "total": 0 }
  - NOT 404 or 500

TC-FILTER-009: Invalid filter value type
Query: minPrice=abc (non-numeric)
Expected: 400 Bad Request, "minPrice must be a number."

TC-FILTER-010: minPrice greater than maxPrice
Query: minPrice=1000&maxPrice=100
Expected: 400, "minPrice cannot be greater than maxPrice."

TC-FILTER-011: Filter with SQL/NoSQL injection
Query: category='; DROP TABLE products; --
Expected: Sanitized — treated as plain text filter value

TC-FILTER-012: Filter with extra unknown parameters
Query: unknownParam=xyz&category=books
Expected: 200, unknown param ignored (or 400 if strict mode)
---

Data Accuracy Verification

TC-FILTER-013: Verify filter result accuracy
Steps:
  1. Apply filter: category=electronics
  2. Pick 5 random items from result
  3. Individually fetch each item by ID
Expected: Each item's category = "electronics" when fetched individually
---

পরিশেষে

Filtering-এর সবচেয়ে critical bug হলো filter leak — অর্থাৎ filter apply করলেও অন্য category-র data মিশে আসা। প্রতিটি filtered result-এর accuracy manually spot-check করা উচিত।

Tags: #FilteringTesting #APITesting #QueryParams #DataAccuracy #QA #SQA
